command: for b in /usr/libexec/cfprefsd /usr/libexec/securityd /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/CoreSymbolication.framework/coresymbolicationd /usr/libexec/mdnsd /usr/libexec/nehelper /usr/sbin/notifyd /usr/libexec/locationd /usr/libexec/nsurlsessiond /System/Library/CoreServices/iconservicesd; do n=$(ldid -e /var/mnt/rootfs$b 2>/dev/null | grep -c "com.apple.private"); echo "$n $b"; done
limit: A timeout kills the local SSH process group; remote work may need explicit cleanup.
